scope: Unused official single-query tasks only; no new benchmark or old-final reuse
multiplicity: Holm; sample-size planning uses worst-case two-sided alpha=0.025
sample_size_method: Paired normal approximation using dev discordance; q at least target delta; planning estimate, not an achieved-power claim
admission: A development enhancement must pass frozen gates and unused official tasks must meet estimated sample size
stop: If no enhancement or inadequate unused pool, do not run final or add modules; retain dev conclusions and archive
near_duplicate_limit: Numeric-normalized query hashes are a narrow screen; same official generator/template origin prevents claiming independent benchmark families
